profile: Precigen is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing precision medicines for immuno-oncology, autoimmune disorders, and infectious diseases. Its approved product, Papzimeos, is an immunotherapy for adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. The company’s platforms include AdenoVerse immunotherapy and UltraCAR-T, and its pipeline includes clinical-stage candidates for cancer. It also developed the UltraPorator device to support manufacturing of UltraCAR-T therapies.
